sloka: तस्मात्त्वं पुष्ययोगेन यौवराज्यमवाप्नुहि ।कामतस्त्वं प्रकृत्यैव विनीतो गुणवानसि ॥२-३-४१॥
transliteration: tasmāttvaṁ puṣyayogena yauvarājyamavāpnuhi ।kāmatastvaṁ prakṛtyaiva vinīto guṇavānasi ॥2-3-41॥

translations.english: Admittedly gentle by nature, you are gifted with virtues. O son, even though virtuous, I shall offer you counsel for your good out of affection for you.
